item.title: Hen'ai
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: VANIRA
  • 発売日: 2000-02-25
  • スコア: なし (2 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 偏愛
  • 英語名: Hen’ai

あらすじ

In the darkness of a sleepless nights the events of ten years ago come to mind. That was the time when main character tried to bind his sister-in-law.

Now hero works as teacher on practice. He did not even dream that working in school would grant him such a wonderful opportunity to practice his bondage skills.

item.title: Magical Deep☆One
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: VANIRA
  • 発売日: 1997-04-18
  • スコア: なし (1 人評価)
  • 日本語名: マジカルディープ☆ワン
  • 英語名: Magical Deep☆One

あらすじ

Princess Ruri arrives from an overseas magical country to train into being a good ruler. If she can help five people with their troubles by using magic, she can become the queen. The protagonist Kyouji who is a high school student agrees to help the princess in exchange for fulfilling one wish if the training goes well.
